description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans reminders table operations using MySQL as the storage backend. It defines a test class with setup methods and several test cases for reminders table functionalities.

classes.name: MySqlRemindersTableTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying Orleans reminders table operations with MySQL backend, inheriting from ReminderTableTestsBase.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logger filter options for tracing logs specific to this test class.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Creates an instance of AdoNetReminderTable configured for MySQL.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the invariant name string for MySQL ADO.NET provider.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a relational storage instance and retrieves its connection string.

methods.name: RemindersTable_MySql_Init
methods.description: A test method for initializing the MySQL reminders table.

methods.name: RemindersTable_MySql_RemindersRange
methods.description: A test method for verifying reminders range functionality with MySQL.

methods.name: RemindersTable_MySql_RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: A test method for verifying parallel upsert operations on reminders table.

methods.name: RemindersTable_MySql_ReminderSimple
methods.description: A test method for verifying simple reminder operations.
